note: The environment both suites read to reach a real warehouse. Held here so the two harnesses cannot drift on a variable name. Connection variables are the vendor's own, which is what the Databricks and Snowflake client libraries read in Python and what odbc::databricks() and odbc::snowflake() read in R, so one export block serves both languages and the vendor CLIs. Fixture variables carry one dotted identifier each. A backend whose required variables are unset skips; an optional fixture skips only the tests that need it.

schema.description: Catalog and schema holding the provisioned tables, as `catalog.schema`. The table names themselves come from live-warehouse-rows.json.

denied_table.description: A relation the test principal genuinely cannot read. Needs an owner other than the test principal, so provisioning cannot finish it.

metric_view.description: A parameterized metric view. Read by the R suite only: pkg-py has no semantic-model surface (commons kata gcgj).

alternate_role.description: A second usable role, for the active-role change test.

semantic_view.description: A semantic view. Read by the R suite only, as with the Databricks metric view.

verified_query_view.description: A semantic view carrying a verified query. Read by the R suite only.
